name: Cleric (2024)
description: Clerics draw power from the realms of the gods and harness it to work miracles, bolster people, and battle foes.
starting_equipment_options: (A) Chain Shirt, Shield, Mace, Holy Symbol, Priest’s Pack, and 7 GP

1.name: Spellcasting
1.description: Access to Cleric spell list, prepare spells. Starts with 3 cantrips, 4 prepared spells.

1.name: Divine Order
1.description: Choose Protector (Martial weapon & Heavy armor proficiency) or Thaumaturge (1 extra Cleric cantrip, bonus to Arcana/Religion checks = Wis mod).

2.name: Channel Divinity (2/rest)
2.description: Use Channel Divinity twice (regain 1 on Short Rest, all on Long). Effects: Divine Spark (heal/damage 1d8+Wis), Turn Undead.

3.name: Cleric Subclass
3.description: Gain a Cleric subclass. (Life Domain is detailed in Basic Rules).

4.name: Ability Score Improvement
4.description: Gain Ability Score Improvement feat or other feat. Learns 1 additional cantrip.

5.name: Sear Undead
5.description: When using Turn Undead, Undead that fail save take Radiant damage = Wis mod d8s.

7.name: Blessed Strikes
7.description: Choose: Divine Strike (once/turn, hit with weapon adds 1d8 Necrotic/Radiant) OR Potent Spellcasting (add Wis mod to Cleric cantrip damage).

10.name: Divine Intervention
10.description: As Magic action, cast any Cleric spell L5 or lower without slot/materials. Once per Long Rest. Learns 1 additional cantrip.

14.name: Improved Blessed Strikes
14.description: Divine Strike damage -> 2d8. Potent Spellcasting: when dealing damage with Cleric cantrip, grant self or ally Temp HP = 2x Wis mod.

19.name: Epic Boon
19.description: Gain an Epic Boon feat or other feat. (Boon of Fate recommended).

20.name: Greater Divine Intervention
20.description: Divine Intervention can cast Wish. If so, can’t use Divine Intervention again until 2d4 Long Rests.
